sentences.text:
The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking following reliefs:-
"10.1 That, the Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct the respondent to pay the interest to the petitioners under section 80 for which they are entitled.
10.2 that, the Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct the competent respondent authority to distribute interest amount as per rules.
10.3 Any other relief or reliefs may also be granted to the petitioners which this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that land of the petitioner was acquired vide award dated 31.03.2017, however, the amount of award was disbursed on 15.01.2024, therefore, in addition to the amount of award, petitioner is also entitled to interest on the award under Section Hem Lal Jaiswal vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25804464/
1 80 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:19280 Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the Act of 2013).
3.

entities.text: Section Hem Lal Jaiswal vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PROVISION

sentences.text:
Section 80 of the Act of 2013 reads as under:-
"80. Payment of interest.- When the amount of such compensation is not paid or deposited on or before taking possession of the land, the Collector shall pay the amount awarded with interest thereon at the rate of nine per cent per annum from the time of so taking possession until it shall have been so paid or deposited:
Provided that if such compensation or any part thereof is not paid or deposited within a period of one year from the date on which possession is taken, interest at the rate of fifteen per cent, per annum shall be payable from the date of expiry of the said period of one year on the amount of compensation or part thereof which has not been paid or deposited before the date of such expiry."

4. Considering the fact that petitioner was paid compensation after a period of more than six years therefore if the petitioner moves an application before respondent No. 3 about the entitlement of interest from date of the possession till date of actual payment, same shall be decided within a period of 90 days from date of representation.
5. Directions given by this Court would be subject to verification of the fact by the authorities concerned so far as the entitlement of compensation to the petitioner is concerned.
6. With the above direction/observation, this writ petition stands disposed of.

Sd/-
